messages:
Sam: Hey team — customer hitting intermittent 503s + very high tail latency on our text-gen endpoint. They gave a request_id: abc123-eu-west-1 and said the window was ~2026-03-16 22:14 UTC. Org: acme-inc-42. Can SRE grab server-side logs (may span shards/regions) and advise next repro steps? Also want a curl we can give them for repro.

Jonathan: @Sam - I can start a log hunt. Can you confirm exact timestamp range (±5m OK) and whether the request_id is the X-Request-Id header or a traced id from the client? If it's the header we search request_id; if trace, search trace.id.

Jonathan: Quick KQL to run in Kibana (prod indices):
```
index: prod-logs-*
(request_id: "abc123-eu-west-1" OR trace.id: "abc123-eu-west-1") AND @timestamp >= "2026-03-16T22:09:00Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-03-16T22:19:00Z"
```
Also check upstream gateway logs (edge cluster eu-west-1) — we may need to query across two shards.

Priya: FYI edge/runtime sometimes strips X-Request-Id on 503 retry paths, so ask customer to include both x-request-id and traceparent header in repro. Example curl we usually give: 
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "x-request-id: abc123-eu-west-1" \
  -H "traceparent: 00-<traceid>-<spanid>-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"short prompt to reproduce latency"}'
```
Include full response headers and body in the reply.

Maya: Heads-up: our hot/online logs retention is 30d. Anything older moves to cold storage shards and needs an archive pull (48–72h lead). If the event falls into cold storage we have to open an export: include index pattern (prod-logs-*) + time range + req id.

Maya: If you want quicker context, run Jonathan's KQL but also check the edge request logs by searching index: edge-requests-* with the same request_id. Sometimes the request hops and the server-side request_id is altered (suffix/prefix).

InfraBot: Ticket #INC-8942 created and linked. Assigned: jonathan, priority: P2. Auto-note: attach debug bundle if available.

Sam: Thanks. I'll ask the customer for the exact ±5m timeframe, full curl with the headers above, and their app-level traceparent if they have it. If they can't reproduce I'll still provide the request_id and ask them to share the raw response headers. Will update here when I have the bundle/response. :thumbsup:

Jonathan: Great — once you paste the exact window I'll run the cross-shard KQL and paste any hits (node, shard id, and raw log lines). If we hit cold-storage I'll kick off an archive export and post ETA.

Priya: If we need to escalate to runtime team, include any patterns from the response (e.g., chunked vs full body, connection resets). That helps narrow whether it's kernel/network vs model backend.

Sam: Copy — collecting now.
